liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Althea** (3 reviews): Reviewer finds this Althea very sweet; Described as a monster Althea [15][17][26]
- **Foolish Heart** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls it an awesome choice to open the show; Reviewer says Jerry's voice needs a couple of minutes to reach proper show-level ripeness in this heavy opener [15][26]
- **Greatest Story Ever Told** (1 review): Reviewer finds it too mellow and slow [26]
- **Candyman** (1 review): Reviewer says Jerry's Candyman vocals were never better than here [17]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Reviewer calls this Let It Grow monstrous [19]
- **Uncle John's Band** (1 review): Named as a standout of the non-stop second set, with Goin' Down the Road and Not Fade Away [15]
- **All Along The Watchtower** (1 review): Reviewer describes this Watchtower as fast and upbeat [24]
- **Believe It Or Not** (1 review): Reviewer hears Jerry pleading rather than singing, with playing right on; track labels are mixed up [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1988-07-17.143173.pre-fm.bm.miller.flac1644** (recommended): pre-FM broadcast master; 23 songs; 268 min [1]
- **gd88-07-17.sbd.jeffm.1808.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 154 min; rated 4.45/5 by 11 [3]. Said about its sound: Known flaws: dropouts at 4:34 and 5:06 on disc 2 track 5 [3]
- **gd1988-07-17.143211.sbd.bm.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 22 songs; 154 min [5]
- **gd88-07-17.schoeps.gardner.9245.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 22 songs; 166 min; rated 4.7/5 by 10 [6]. Said about its sound: Audience recording sounds so good the reviewer says no soundboard would be needed [25]
- **gd88-07-17.sbd-matrix.braverman.10081.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 150 min; rated 4.63/5 by 19 [9]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the matrix a top-shelf recording with premium sound; Big, full, thunderous sound with prominent Phil bass (Modulus) and a great instrument and vocal mix [16][17]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended with a friend who taped; it was their only Greek show, after a trip from the east coast [19]
- Hottest July day in both cities: 105F in San Francisco and 97F in Berkeley [20]
- There is stage banter between Big River and Candyman, and file names are mislabeled [25]
- Reviewer rates this the hottest show of that summer, with other FM recordings circulating from the same run [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1988-07-17.143173.pre-fm.bm.miller.flac1644**: taped by David Gans; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Pre-FM (KPFA Air-Check) > Beta HiFi Master (Sony ES-HG) [1]. Also: Recorded by David Gans at KPFA; this FLAC file set is 16 bit, 44.1 kHz [1]
- **gd88-07-17.sbd.jeffm.1808.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> DAT Master> CDR> EAC> WAV> SHN [3]
- **gd1988-07-17.143211.sbd.bm.miller.flac1644**: taped by David Gans; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: In-House FM (SBD) > Beta HiFi Master (Sony ES-HG) [5]. Also: Pure soundboard feed without ambient mics, recorded by David Gans at KPFA; 16 bit, 44.1 kHz [5]
- **gd88-07-17.schoeps.gardner.9245.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Sean Weber-small; transferred by PCM Master-> Sony PCM 601ES -> RME Hammerfall > Soundforge 4.5/CD Architect > CDR by Sean Weber-small; EAC (Plex 8x, see log in individual folders) > Shn via MKW .97 by Bill Gardner; source: 2nd Row Behind Healy (see notes). Schoeps CMC42S (Spaced Omni 10' Split --> Oade Power Supply --> Sony PCM-F1 with Apogee modified A/D filters. [6]
- **gd88-07-17.sbd-matrix.braverman.10081.sbeok.shnf**: source: Ultramatrix (SBD/AUD mix)> DAT> ?> CD ("?" may not be a generation, or it may be. I dunno.) [9]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Jerry Garcia: [1988-07-17 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1988-07-17-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [28]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1988-07-17 Grateful Dead Ticket - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1988-07-17-grateful-dead-ticket/) [29]
